Run managed daemon processes at background priority on macOS (#54401)

## What changed

- Launch managed processes through `taskpolicy -b` on macOS when a five-second probe succeeds, preserving the managed process PID. Fall back to direct launch if the probe fails or times out.
- Increase the macOS startup timeout from 10 to 30 seconds to accommodate background CPU and I/O scheduling, and serialize daemon startup test fixtures on macOS.
- Use the shared background command helper and retain `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` alongside Windows detachment flags.

## Testing

Add macOS tests for PID preservation, background priority when available, and direct-launch fallback after a probe timeout.

Preserve existing SQLite journal modes on startup (#54389)

## Why
